summary: First draft of ADR-010: the operator edits the Excalidraw scene (the store); the scene-view projection turns it into the aof Mermaid view (the interface); the architect reads it through context and writes an edited view through propose, which lands as review records the operator previews and accepts in the editor.
rationale: The ADR has no diagram brief, so the draft follows ADR-010 itself: its two readers (the person in the editor, the architect), the one stored file (the canonical .excalidraw scene), the pure scene-view projection into the Mermaid profile, the context and propose actions, and the review records that name Mermaid ids. The two subgraphs carry the ADR's central split: the store holds everything Excalidraw draws, the interface is the text the architect reads and writes. No project library item fits (the only library is AWS icons), so every node is a plain shape. No ADR amendment is implied.
